properties.name: spring.flyway.enabled
properties.description: Whether the application should run Flyway migrations during startup.

properties.name: spring.flyway.baseline-on-migrate
properties.description: Whether Flyway should baseline an existing non-empty schema before running migrations.

properties.name: app.frontend.origins
properties.description: Comma-separated frontend origins allowed by CORS.

properties.name: app.auth.issuer
properties.description: Issuer claim used in application auth tokens.

properties.name: app.auth.jwt-secret
properties.description: Secret used to sign application auth tokens.

properties.name: app.auth.cookie-name
properties.description: Name of the HttpOnly auth cookie.

properties.name: app.auth.cookie-secure
properties.description: Whether the auth cookie should only be sent over HTTPS.

properties.name: app.auth.cookie-same-site
properties.description: SameSite policy for the auth cookie.
